section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Brazilian Figure Rating Scale (FRS), an instrument validated by Kakeshita (2008) for assessing body image perception and dissatisfaction in children aged 7-12 years. The instrument consists of 11 silhouettes per sex ranging from BMI 12 to 29 kg/m², and participants select silhouettes representing their current body image and desired body image to measure perceptual accuracy and body dissatisfaction. No specific study data, sample characteristics, or correlation statistics are presented in this section.
